name: Guide title and product blurb
does: Names the repo and the WhatsApp-ordering product
costNote: always in every main and subagent context

name: Workflow section heading
does: Heading only

name: Prefer dedicated tools over bash
does: Use Read/Edit/Write/Grep/Glob instead of cat/sed/echo/grep/find

name: Explain before acting
does: Summarize planned approach before editing when the ask is not explicit
preventsClaim: agent edits files straight from the prompt without agreeing an approach
costNote: one confirmation round per ambiguous instruction

name: Sweep a review note branch-wide
does: Grep the branch diff for every instance of a flagged pattern, fix all, report count
preventsClaim: only the flagged line gets fixed and the class recurs
costNote: one grep sweep per review note

name: Claim only verified work
does: Re-read the diff before a done-report claims a change; read call sites before an analysis
preventsClaim: a done-report or analysis claims work that is not in the diff

name: Fix the guidance you disprove
does: Correct a wrong CLAUDE.md or design-doc line in the same commit
preventsClaim: wrong guidance stays and misleads the next run

name: No co-author trailers
does: Never append Co-authored-by to a commit; overrides harness default
preventsClaim: harness default adds an unwanted trailer

name: Conventional commit and PR titles
does: Prefix commits and PR titles with feat:/fix:/docs:/refactor:/chore:
preventsClaim: squash merge inherits a non-conventional subject

name: SKILL.md holds operative steps only
does: Put rationale in README.md, and only when it exists; no default README
preventsClaim: rationale bloats the file loaded on every skill invocation

name: Write skill steps in plain terms
does: No design jargon in steps a cheap model executes
preventsClaim: a haiku subagent cannot follow a jargon-worded step

name: Never PR a branch holding .mise/
does: Block PR/merge while the mise directory exists; run /mise:next first
preventsClaim: in-flight workflow state ships to main

name: Architecture headings
does: Headings only

name: Core entity relations
does: States Business 1:N OrderLocation 1:N Order

name: Authentication model heading
does: Heading only

name: Consumers have no auth accounts
does: Forbids assuming a consumer login, session, or auth-protected consumer surface
preventsClaim: agent designs a consumer login that cannot exist

name: Only staff and owners authenticate
does: Scopes UserClaims to staff and business owners

name: Consumer terms captured at checkout
does: Terms version bumps take effect at the next Stripe checkout, no re-prompt middleware
preventsClaim: agent builds a re-prompt path that has no surface to run on

name: Key commands heading
does: Heading only

name: Canonical yarn command list
does: Lists build-tsc, build, lint, test, test <path>
costNote: always loaded; each command is a tool run

name: Only yarn scripts, never raw tools
does: Forbids calling tsc, eslint, or vitest directly
preventsClaim: a raw runner misses repo config such as the pinned TZ

name: Validation order after changes
does: build-tsc then lint then scoped test; full build only when complete
preventsClaim: slow full build run after every intermediate edit

name: Start test emulator without asking
does: Run yarn test:up freely; it is idempotent and isolates data per checkout
preventsClaim: agent stops to ask the user before starting the emulator
costNote: one tmux session start per machine

name: Dev environment command list
does: Names dev:setup, dev:up, dev:down, clean, wt:rm and their docs

name: Business logic heading
does: Heading and pointer to docs/design/

name: Design doc index
does: Links 12 design docs plus the design README
costNote: always loaded; each linked doc is on-demand

name: Key points heading
does: Heading plus commission pricing fact

name: All queries go through db-refs
does: Forbids raw Firestore collection access

name: Payment handling heading
does: Heading only

name: Money before state
does: Perform the Stripe operation before committing a status change
preventsClaim: DB says done while money is not secured

name: Guard invariants before side effects
does: Throw at the outermost caller on a missing required field; never log-and-skip
preventsClaim: corruption hides behind a silent skip or a quietly wrong total

name: Errors bubble up
does: Let errors propagate to the caller
preventsClaim: business cannot see a failure and take action

name: Retries must stay possible
does: Never advance to a state that blocks a retry
preventsClaim: a failed payment leaves an unretryable state

name: Notifications are not critical path
does: Log and return success when a WhatsApp notification fails after critical work
preventsClaim: a WhatsApp outage fails the whole operation

name: Notification functions own their copy
does: send* functions take enums for message variants, never raw text
preventsClaim: caller-built strings scatter customer copy across the codebase

name: Code style heading
does: Heading only

name: Never use non-null assertions
does: Use guards with early returns or continue instead of !

name: Assign before reading a property
does: Bind a call result to a const before reading a property off it

name: Use undefined not null
does: Absent values are | undefined in return types and optional fields

name: Omit absent fields
does: Build results with conditional spreads; never write explicit undefined

name: Optional means a caller omits it
does: Make a field required and fix call sites when every caller fills it
preventsClaim: an optional that everyone fills hides the one caller that forgot

name: Comments above code never inline
does: Place a comment on the line above the code

name: Comment line width near 80
does: Pack comments close to the 80-char cap, no early wrap
preventsClaim: comments wrapped at ~70 chars waste lines

name: JSDoc grounds the reader
does: State the product moment and output; never name consumers; mechanics go inline
preventsClaim: a maintainer without context cannot tell what an export is for

name: Comment register follows doc-style
does: Defers hard length caps, plain words, and the rewrite pass to the doc-style skill
costNote: pointer only; the skill body is a separate 92-line load

name: Blank line separates setup const
does: Separate a setup const from its use; keep related declarations tight

name: Declare near use
does: A const sits immediately above its first use

name: Use arrow functions
does: Arrow function form only

name: Casing conventions
does: PascalCase types, camelCase values, kebab-case enum values unless external

name: Enum over const string array
does: A closed vocabulary is an enum; build lists with Object.values
preventsClaim: a literal string array forces satisfies re-checks at every use site

name: No abbreviations in identifiers
does: Full words except standard short forms id, url, api, db

name: Unused parameters are a bare underscore
does: Placeholder args are _, never _unused

name: Reuse existing vocabulary
does: Grep for the term the surrounding code already uses before coining one
preventsClaim: a second name for one concept enters the codebase

name: Function verbs come from naming.md
does: Every exported function starts with a verb from the accepted-vocabulary table; new verbs added there
preventsClaim: a new verb enters without landing in the table
costNote: pointer; naming.md is a 148-line on-demand read

name: English-only identifiers
does: Spanish only in user-facing strings, never in names

name: Okven capitalized in prose
does: Capitalize Okven everywhere except slugs and identifiers

name: Always yarn never npm or npx
does: Forbids npm and npx

name: validate versus check prefixes
does: validate* transforms data, check* verifies state or permission

name: Never re-export types
does: Update all import sites when a type moves to a shared package

name: Exhaustive switches with assertNever
does: Bind the discriminant to a const, default calls assertNever and throws a named error
preventsClaim: a new enum member silently falls through

name: Result wrapper naming and granularity
does: Name wrappers <Action>Result/<Action>ResultType; split a member whose copy has to hedge
preventsClaim: one result member forces copy that hedges across unrelated customer situations

name: Classifying enums end in Type
does: Never Kind; the discriminator field is type

name: ID aliases are documentation-only
does: No as <ID> casts; they have zero type-safety effect
preventsClaim: a cast that does nothing suggests type safety it does not provide

name: File naming heading
does: Heading only

name: One export per file
does: Each file exports exactly one function or class

name: File name matches export
does: File name exactly matches the exported symbol

name: Index files use export star
does: Always export * rather than named re-exports

name: types.ts and constants.ts split
does: types.ts holds pure types, constants.ts holds runtime values; single-consumer constants live with the consumer

name: internal/ is export surface not test exemption
does: Directory-local helpers go in internal/ and still need colocated tests for every branch
preventsClaim: internal/ placement is read as an excuse to skip tests

name: Shared packages only for cross-package use
does: Colocate types and enums used within one package

name: Testing heading
does: Headings only

name: No describe blocks
does: Only it() statements
costNote: always loaded; the one test-style rule with lint backing (eslint.config.mjs:194-205)

name: No mock cleanup calls
does: Never call vi.clearAllMocks or vi.resetAllMocks

name: Mock external dependencies only
does: Mock third-party libs; never mock internal code; lists four exceptions including router sub-handlers
preventsClaim: mocking internal code makes tests brittle, hides bugs, breaks on refactor

name: Always use inline snapshots
does: toMatchInlineSnapshot on whole values; bans toContain/toBe/toMatchObject/objectContaining/plain toThrow; requires a // Verify: comment
preventsClaim: a cherry-picked or hand-built expectation hides regressions in fields the author did not think to assert

name: No drilling inside expect
does: Bans .length, index, .at(), .map(), field reads inside expect; inject the threshold or use one named digest helper
preventsClaim: a drilled assertion hides the rest of the value

name: Normalize Firestore data in snapshots
does: Wrap Timestamp/Buffer data with normalizeData before snapshotting

name: No as any casts in tests
does: Use proper types in tests

name: Run tests with yarn only
does: yarn test or yarn test <path>

name: Imports end in .js
does: ESM requirement for all imports

name: Check before adding tests
does: Read existing test bodies to confirm the scenario is uncovered and titles match assertions
preventsClaim: a duplicate test, or a title that names something its assertions never prove

name: Test scenarios not individual outputs
does: Group assertions for one action in one it(); never map input scenarios into one snapshot

name: Routing tests stay shallow
does: Router test asserts dispatch plus one reply; match the nearest sibling's shape
preventsClaim: scenario depth duplicated in the router test

name: Never bulk-regenerate snapshots
does: Update one file at a time and read every regenerated snapshot
preventsClaim: a snapshot that changed for an unnamed reason is a bug refreshed away

name: Use __mocks__ for module mocks
does: Full module mocks live in __mocks__ directories

name: Functions tests need the emulator
does: yarn test:up/down/attach; test runs pinned to TZ=Etc/Universal via scripts/test-run.ts
preventsClaim: a bare vitest run inherits the host zone and makes date tests pass locally, fail in CI

name: Package guides load automatically
does: Points at functions/, hosting/, packages/ CLAUDE.md
costNote: always loaded; the three targets are lazy nested_memory attachments

name: Frontend section heading
does: Separator and headings

name: ui-conventions required before Vue edits
does: Invoke the ui-conventions skill before writing or editing any Vue component or page
preventsClaim: guessing Tailwind classes that the strict UnoCSS preset silently drops
costNote: loads a 169-line skill per UI task

name: ui-verify required before reporting done
does: Invoke ui-verify after UI changes: render, screenshot mobile, check console, exercise states
preventsClaim: typecheck alone is claimed as UI verification
costNote: spawns 3 subagents per pass, re-spawned per fix round

name: Todoist default project
does: Okven - R&D id 6XCj9JhwCfqr95Fm is the default Todoist project

name: Backlog task title format
does: [type] verb + what + outcome, lowercase, one outcome, [spike] for research

name: Backlog section semantics
does: Table mapping Doing/Waiting/To Do (Urgent)/To Do/Next Big Projects to their use

name: Out-of-scope findings become Todoist items
does: Library helpers and project-wide fixes found on a branch become backlog items, not code changes
preventsClaim: a branch grows beyond its scope
